item.tib: dgra bgegs spyi 'joms kyi zor las thog mda' dmar po
item.coloph: phung mgon thugs kyi yang snying brnag pa/ pom ra'i gsang gter/ dregs pa bco brgyad kyi rno so/ gza' bdud gshin rje'i thog gi gzer mda'/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi thog mda'/ ge shan dun tse byad ma'i srog gi spu gri/ drag po zor gyi bsgrub pa/ khro gnyer gyi (gnyen gyis) gter ma'o/ dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod gyur cig/
